note: The implementer may change only a feature's "passes" value, from false to true, in the card named by "card". scripts/guard.mjs enforces this.

features.feature: The project installs, type checks, tests and opens a window
steps: Run pwsh scripts/init.ps1
Run npm run dev
A window shows HSOS

features.feature: The typed bus validates, times out and never throws
steps: Run npm test -- tests/shell/bus.test.ts
All BUS and SHELL-16 to SHELL-19 tests pass

features.feature: The renderer reaches all three services
steps: Run the bus end-to-end test
Three pong answers arrive

features.feature: A dead service restarts on its own
steps: Kill workspace-service
A crash file appears
The service is ready again within 5 seconds

features.feature: One frameless window that remembers its place
steps: Launch twice
One window exists
Move it, restart, it reopens in the same place

features.feature: Settings changes apply live
steps: Edit settings.json on disk
The change applies within one second without restart

features.feature: Themes switch without a reload
steps: Add a second theme file to the themes folder
Pick it with Ctrl+K Ctrl+T
Colours change at once
Pick Phosphor again

features.feature: Command palette
steps: Press Ctrl+Shift+P
Type 'set'
Open Settings runs from the list

features.feature: Settings screen
steps: Press Ctrl+,
Change a value
Invalid input shows a message and is not saved

features.feature: Stage 0 survives bad settings and a renderer crash, and packages
steps: Corrupt settings.json and launch
The window opens with the problem banner
Kill the renderer; the window reloads
npm run dist produces an installer

features.feature: A new project opens with the default layout
steps: Open a folder never opened before
Files on the left, one terminal, HUD on the right

features.feature: Layouts come back after a restart
steps: Make two splits and three tabs
Restart HSOS
The same layout and focus return

features.feature: A terminal runs PowerShell with the theme's colours
steps: Open a terminal
Run echo hsos-ok
The text appears

features.feature: Copy, paste, Shift+Enter and drops behave correctly
steps: Select text and press Ctrl+C: it copies
Press Ctrl+C with no selection: it interrupts
Paste 30 lines: a confirmation shows
Drop a file: its quoted path is typed

features.feature: Shells survive a UI reload
steps: Run a counter loop
Kill the renderer
The terminal reattaches and the counter keeps rising

features.feature: Terminal history returns after a restart
steps: Print a marker
Restart HSOS
The marker shows above the restored divider

features.feature: Shells keep running across project switches
steps: Run a counter in project A
Open project B, then A
The counter has advanced

features.feature: Four terminals stay responsive under heavy output
steps: Print 50 MB in one terminal
Type in another
Echo stays under 50 ms

features.feature: Saving keeps encoding and line endings and never overwrites outside changes
steps: Save a CRLF UTF-8 BOM file
Its bytes differ only in the edit
Change it outside and save: the save is refused

features.feature: Go to file
steps: Press Ctrl+P
Type part of a file name
The best match is first; Enter opens it

features.feature: File tree
steps: Expand folders
Rename with F2
Delete sends to the Recycle Bin after confirmation

features.feature: Viewer for code, markdown and images
steps: Open a .ts file: syntax colours
Open a .md file: preview, toggle to source
Open a .png: the image

features.feature: Outside changes never destroy unsaved edits
steps: Edit a file without saving
Change it outside HSOS
The bar offers Compare, Reload, Overwrite; nothing is written until chosen

features.feature: Unsaved edits survive a crash
steps: Type in a file without saving
Kill HSOS
Relaunch: the edit is back, unsaved

features.feature: Every version of a file can be restored
steps: Change a file several times, some outside HSOS
Open Show File History
Restore an old version; Undo puts the newer one back

features.feature: Files survive service crashes and write errors
steps: Run the stage 2 fault tests
REL-2, REL-3, REL-10, REL-12 pass

features.feature: Claude sessions are tracked from hooks
steps: FakeClaude posts a prompt, a permission request and a stop
The session goes working, needs you, done

features.feature: Subagents and a snapshot before every Claude edit
steps: FakeClaude spawns a subagent with model haiku
It is listed with haiku
A pre-edit hook leaves a baseline snapshot

features.feature: Usage limits, context and cost arrive from the statusline
steps: FakeClaude posts statusline JSON with rate limits
The limits and context are stored

features.feature: Sync with GitHub, fast-forward only
steps: Remote is ahead, tree clean: auto pull
Tree dirty: no pull
Sync pushes local commits

features.feature: Branch button and worktree sessions
steps: The title bar shows branch and ahead and behind
New Claude Session in Worktree opens a terminal in a new worktree

features.feature: Attention board and notifications
steps: A session needs you while HSOS is unfocused
A Windows notification shows
The HUD lists it first; selecting it focuses its terminal

features.feature: Usage bars with reset times
steps: Limits arrive
5 hours and 7 days bars show percentages and reset times
Status bar shows 5h and 7d

features.feature: Skills deck and skills repo row
steps: Search a skill and activate it: /name is typed into the Claude terminal
Star it: it moves first
The repo row shows sync state

features.feature: Session recap
steps: Leave a Claude terminal for over a minute while it works
Return: a one-line recap shows
A key press removes it

features.feature: Activity timeline with causes
steps: Claude edits a file
Activity shows it under the session's title
An outside change shows as Outside

features.feature: Artifacts inbox
steps: Claude creates report.pdf
It appears in Artifacts
Search finds it; Open opens it

features.feature: Changes view with live diffs
steps: Claude edits files
Changes lists them since the last commit or since the session began
The diff updates live

features.feature: Feedback tray
steps: Pin comments on diff lines
Send to Claude
The composed prompt is pasted without Enter

features.feature: Stage 3 end to end and link-service crash
steps: Run the stage 3 end-to-end and fault tests
They pass

features.feature: Browser panel
steps: Open a browser tab
Type localhost:3000
Open the palette: it shows above the page

features.feature: Owner stays in control of Claude's browsing
steps: Claude navigates to an outside host: a permission bar asks
While Claude controls the tab a frame and Stop show
Stop makes Claude's next action fail

features.feature: Element capture
steps: Press Ctrl+Shift+X and click an element
Add comment puts it in the feedback tray
Send to Claude pastes its HTML and styles

features.feature: Claude drives the browser through the hsos command
steps: In Git Bash with an HSOS terminal environment: hsos browser navigate, snapshot, click, type
The page responds

features.feature: Claude shows files and diffs without stealing focus
steps: hsos workspace open-file while typing in a terminal
The file opens in the background; the terminal keeps focus

features.feature: Stage 4 end to end
steps: Run the stage 4 end-to-end test
It passes

features.feature: Graph view
steps: Open the graph
Notes, CLAUDE.md files, skills and memory show in their colours
Hover fades unrelated nodes; filters work

features.feature: Local graph, backlinks and preview links
steps: Open a note
The local graph and backlinks follow it
Wiki links in the preview open their notes

features.feature: The graph stays smooth with 5 000 notes
steps: Index a 5 000 note vault
Idle frame rate is at least 55

features.feature: Live theme editor
steps: Duplicate Phosphor
Change the accent: the window updates at once
A low-contrast text colour shows Low

features.feature: Reliability bar REL-1 to REL-10
steps: Run the reliability tests three times
All pass every time

features.feature: Property test and two-hour soak
steps: Run the property test
Run npm run soak
Both pass

features.feature: Performance budgets measured
steps: Run the performance test
Every value is recorded; none is 50 percent over budget

features.feature: Installer and first-run checks
steps: Run the installer without administrator rights
First launch lists Git, Claude Code, GitHub CLI and PowerShell 7 checks

features.feature: Dictation apps and Shift+Enter work in every terminal
steps: Put text on the clipboard and send Shift+Insert from another program: the text lands in the terminal
In PowerShell, type a command, press Shift+Enter, type another, press Enter: both run as separate lines
Paste 6 000 characters into a program using bracketed paste: no confirmation

features.feature: Prompt marks and live folder
steps: Run three commands, press Ctrl+Up: the view jumps to the previous prompt
cd to another folder, restart HSOS: the restored terminal starts in that folder

features.feature: Spoken alerts
steps: Start a Claude session in a background tab
When it finishes, its title and "Finished" are spoken
Looking at that terminal when it finishes: nothing is spoken

features.feature: Claude setup view
steps: Show Claude Setup
MCP servers, plugins, skills, subagents, hooks and permissions are listed with scope and last use
Not used in 30 days narrows the list; Ask Claude to remove types a request into the Claude terminal

features.feature: Agent view in the graph
steps: Show What Claude Loads at Start
The summary counts the start files and their lines
Notes no link reaches are muted; a note's card shows the chain of links that reaches it

features.feature: Claude sessions survive crashes and restarts
steps: Start a Claude session and talk to it
End HSOS from the Task Manager
Start HSOS: the terminal resumes the same conversation with no typing

features.feature: Find and read any Claude session
steps: Find Claude Session lists every session of the project, including ones started outside HSOS
Open transcript shows the conversation
Resume in new terminal continues it; a running session offers Go to terminal instead

features.feature: Session history of every project
steps: Show Session History lists sessions of all projects, grouped by project
Rename one: the new name shows in HSOS and in Claude Code /resume
Delete two: they go to the Recycle Bin; a running session is skipped

features.feature: Skill state and skills folder from the HUD
steps: Open skills folder opens the skills folder in Explorer
Set a skill to Off: only its skillOverrides entry changes in the settings file
A plugin skill shows why it cannot be changed

features.feature: Quick bar of Claude commands
steps: Usage, Context and Skills open from the bar
Model, effort and mode change from buttons; Compact and Clear ask first
With text typed in the terminal, a button types the command and does not press Enter

features.feature: Everything moves and the background runs
steps: Open the demo
Buttons spring when pressed, menus and dialogs scale in, numbers roll
With Windows animation effects off, only short fades remain and the background stands still

features.feature: Dashboard, Code and Notes pages with seamless transitions
steps: Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2, Ctrl+3 switch pages through a slide
The background never restarts
A terminal keeps printing while its page is hidden

features.feature: Session ribbon and mascot above every Claude terminal
steps: A long chat keeps model, effort, folder, repo and chat name in view
The mascot dances while Claude works and waves when it needs you
Pressing it lists the subagents

features.feature: HUD look finished
steps: Every HUD section shows demo data with its motion
Each section shows its empty and error state in the gallery

features.feature: Notes page
steps: The graph and a note open side by side on the Notes page
Opening the notes widget moves its graph into the page

features.feature: Widget dashboard like a phone home screen
steps: Hold on a widget: edit mode starts and widgets sway
Drag and resize snap to the grid; overlapping places are refused
Swipe between screens; add and remove widgets with undo

features.feature: Ribbon on real sessions
steps: Start Claude in a GitHub repo
The ribbon shows owner/repo and the branch; pressing it opens the repo page

features.feature: Stage 9 end to end
steps: Run the stage 9 end-to-end test
It passes
